makes.blurb: The best-selling carmaker on Earth. Built its name on durability, then proved it could do excitement too — the 2000GT, the Supra, and a Land Cruiser that outlasts its owners.
makes.knownFor: Reliability, hybrids, the Land Cruiser
makes.name: Toyota

makes.blurb: An engine company that happens to build cars. VTEC, the NSX, and a Civic for every budget and every era of a driver's life.
makes.knownFor: VTEC engines, the NSX, motorcycle-grade engineering
makes.name: Honda

makes.blurb: Home of Godzilla. The GT-R line spent five decades embarrassing supercars, and the Z car made performance democratic.
makes.knownFor: GT-R, the Z cars, the Skyline lineage
makes.name: Nissan

makes.blurb: The small company that bet on rotary engines and lightweight roadsters when nobody else would. The MX-5 is the best-selling two-seat sports car in history.
makes.knownFor: MX-5 Miata, rotary engines, driver-first tuning
makes.name: Mazda

makes.blurb: All-wheel drive and boxer engines, everywhere, always. Rally stages made the WRX a legend; the Outback made wagons into a lifestyle.
makes.knownFor: Symmetrical AWD, rally heritage, boxer engines
makes.name: Subaru

makes.blurb: The fastest climb in the industry — from budget punchline in the 1990s to design-led EVs and the N performance division that embarrasses hot hatches twice its price.
makes.knownFor: Ioniq 5, N performance cars, value engineering
makes.name: Hyundai

makes.blurb: Put the world on wheels with the Model T, then gave it the Mustang and the F-Series. The company that beat Ferrari at Le Mans out of spite.
makes.knownFor: Mustang, F-Series trucks, the Model T
makes.name: Ford

makes.blurb: GM's volume brand and America's performance bargain. The Corvette has been the attainable supercar since 1953; the small-block V8 powered everything.
makes.knownFor: Corvette, Camaro, small-block V8
makes.name: Chevrolet

makes.blurb: Born for war, kept for weekends. The Wrangler is the direct descendant of the Willys MB, and the seven-slot grille is the most copied face in off-roading.
makes.knownFor: Wrangler, trail capability, the original SUV
makes.name: Jeep

makes.blurb: Forced the entire industry to go electric. The Model S proved EVs could be the fast option; the Model Y became the best-selling car in the world, of any kind.
makes.knownFor: Electric range and charging network, direct sales
makes.name: Tesla

makes.blurb: Started with aircraft engines, defined the sports sedan with the 3 Series, and built the M division into a byword for fast cars that still steer properly.
makes.knownFor: 3 Series, M cars, inline-six engines
makes.name: BMW

makes.blurb: Benz built the first automobile in 1886 and the company has been previewing the industry's future in the S-Class ever since. The 300SL is the collector benchmark.
makes.knownFor: S-Class, 300SL Gullwing, luxury and safety firsts
makes.name: Mercedes-Benz

makes.blurb: One car, perfected for sixty years: the 911. Around it, Porsche built the most profitable sports-car company in the world without diluting the recipe.
makes.knownFor: 911, motorsport dominance, engineering discipline
makes.name: Porsche

makes.blurb: The people's car, literally. The Beetle is one of the best-selling designs ever; the Golf GTI invented the hot hatch; the Bus became a cultural era on wheels.
makes.knownFor: Beetle, Golf GTI, the Bus
makes.name: Volkswagen

makes.blurb: Quattro all-wheel drive changed rallying forever in 1980, then changed road cars. Audi sells technology and restraint in equal measure.
makes.knownFor: Quattro AWD, interiors, Le Mans diesel era
makes.name: Audi

makes.blurb: A racing team that sells road cars to fund itself, and has never once pretended otherwise. V12s, scarlet paint, and waiting lists measured in years.
makes.knownFor: V12 flagships, Formula 1, limited-run specials
makes.name: Ferrari

makes.blurb: Ferruccio built tractors, got insulted by Enzo Ferrari, and answered with the Miura. Lamborghini has been the loud answer ever since — Countach posters defined a generation's bedroom walls.
makes.knownFor: Countach, V12 drama, wedge design
makes.name: Lamborghini

makes.blurb: Gave the world the three-point seat belt and refused to patent it. Boxy wagons became a design language; the 240 simply refuses to die.
makes.knownFor: Safety, wagons, Scandinavian restraint
makes.name: Volvo

makes.blurb: The E-Type was called the most beautiful car ever made by Enzo Ferrari himself. Jaguar's history swings between genius and chaos, usually in the same decade.
makes.knownFor: E-Type, XK engines, Le Mans wins in the 1950s
makes.name: Jaguar

makes.blurb: The 1948 Series I was a stopgap built from war-surplus aluminium; it became the default vehicle of farms, armies, and expeditions on every continent.
makes.knownFor: Defender, Range Rover, expedition pedigree
makes.name: Land Rover
